title: Toward AI epidemiology: a measurement standardization framework for prospective risk detection
abstract: arXiv:2512.15783v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper proposes a measurement standardization framework that compresses expert-AI interactions into structured, comparable fields for prospective risk detection in deployed AI systems, without access to model internals. This concept paper defines the framework's scope, semantically and statistically, and specifies a protocol for its empirical testing. The population-level claims it is designed to support therefore belong to a staged research program rather than to results claimed here. Measurement standardization underpins three claims. The first is a reliability claim: under bounded conditions, large language models can produce reliable, standardized assessments of the evidential and policy alignment of expert-AI interactions. The second is a governance claim: alignment scores give experts an immediate signal during deployment and give institutions a basis for monitoring alignment patterns across mission types, models, and domai

translated_title: 迈向AI流行病学：用于前瞻性风险检测的测量标准化框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种测量标准化框架，该框架将专家-AI交互压缩为结构化、可比较的字段，用于在已部署AI系统中进行前瞻性风险检测，且无需访问模型内部结构。这篇概念论文从语义和统计角度定义了该框架的范围，并规定了其实证测试的协议。因此，该框架旨在支持的群体层面的主张属于一个分阶段的研究计划，而非本文所声称的研究结果。测量标准化支撑三项主张。第一项是可靠性主张：在有限的条件下，大语言模型能够对专家-AI交互的证据一致性和政策一致性做出可靠、标准化的评估。第二项是治理主张：一致性分数在部署期间为专家提供即时信号，并为机构提供了跨任务类型、模型和领域监测一致性模式的基础。
tldr: 本文提出一个测量标准化框架，将专家-AI交互压缩为结构化、可比较的字段，无需访问模型内部即可对已部署的AI系统进行前瞻性风险检测，并支撑可靠性与治理两方面的主张。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a measurement standardization framework that compresses expert-AI interactions into structured, comparable fields, enabling prospective risk detection in deployed AI systems without access to model internals, underpinning both reliability and governance claims.
